oral_examination.oral_examination: 21 had a crown and root fracture, the labial side was 3-4mm below the gums, 11 had a large area of ​​resin filling, 22 had mesioproximal caries, and no obvious pain.

treatment_plan.definitive: Plan 1: 21 plucking and planting at the same time\nPlan 2: 11,21 pile crown repair, 22 filling\nThe patient requested a trial trial of retaining the affected tooth. He chose option two, informed the relevant risks and costs, and agreed to the treatment.
treatment_plan.notes: Avoid acidic foods within a week and avoid hot and cold stimulation. Maintain oral hygiene as directed by your doctor and rinse with mouthwash. Regular re-examination and follow-up treatment if any discomfort occurs.
